QUOTE: "`mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque` is what stops the optimiser seeing through the mask. In the asm path it is `asm volatile("" : [x] "+r"(x))`. In the C path it is `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`, where `mbedtls_ct_zero` is a `volatile` global" and "The primitives live in `library/constant_time_impl.h`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the compiler barrier and places the primitives in library/constant_time_impl.h. It never says outright that the function itself is defined there, but the context implies it.
